caption: The drawing depicts a single decorative object placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object is a sculpted head, possibly of a mythological or classical figure, rendered in dark gray and black tones with some subtle highlights. The figure has a neutral facial expression with straight features, framed by stylized locks of hair and adorned with a headdress made of large, overlapping leaves. Two large, curved bands resembling drapery or laurel branches drop down on either side of the face, meeting at the bottom in a circular medallion. The object appears metallic, possibly bronze or a similar material, suggested by its shaded, slightly lustrous appearance. The signature "Grace Halpin" is present in small text in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Door Knocker
